title: Pickleball-Basketball-HeatedPool-Spa-2 Primary BRs
description: This spacious home offers the ultimate convenience and location in Scottsdale. Just 5 minutes from Kierland Commons, 10 minutes from the WM Open & Barrett-Jackson, and 20 minutes from the airport and Old Town Scottsdale, you’re at the center of it all! Enjoy nearby attractions like Topgolf, Talking Stick Casino, and other family-friendly outings within a 15-minute drive. This home is perfect for large groups, business retreats, golf trips and families looking for a central hub in Scottsdale.
amenities: Pack ’n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Perfect place for our girls trip! The house was huge and we never felt like we were on top of each other. House rules are reasonable and it was easy to check in, get WiFi, etc. Would book this exact house every year if we could!

This home was perfect for our family. The kids had a blast. Basketball, pickle ball, jacuzzi, pool, games and a child friendly floor for the kids to sleep and play. Every thing was close by, stores, gyms, church, restaurants and malls. Jason was responsive and very thoughtful.  Will visit again.

Well where do I start! Everything was just like the picture and my team really enjoyed the basketball court 🏀. We felt right at home with the amazing space throughout the house. 5 stars ⭐️ place for sure

This place was fantastic! Great location with it being super close to grocery stores. The photos are spot on with what the house actually looks like. It accommodated all of our guest comfortably and everyone spoke highly of the house. Definitely will be booking this place anytime I’m in Scottsdale.
Staying here was great! The place was actually better than advertised, with so much space and a great outdoor area for a large group. Jason was fantastic as well. Would definitely stay here again!

This house was extremely beautiful. There was about 10 of us and each of us had a bedroom. The pool was clean. The jacuzzi was clean. Everything was working from the basketball court to the pickleball fence. The neighborhood was extremely nice. The location was 15 to 20 minutes from most outings we went to and there is a bunch of grocery stores, gas station and nearby attractions to the house. Overall if you have a big party, I would recommend booking this location.
